tenantFilter.description: The tenant's default domain or tenant ID. Must name one tenant; the leaver and every recipient are looked up in it. Use the same value when polling ListOneDriveCopyToUser.

leaver.description: UPN or object id of the user whose OneDrive is copied. A string or a {label,value} object.

recipients.description: UPNs or object ids of the users who receive the copy (at most 10). An array of strings or {label,value} objects, or one comma-separated string. Each recipient needs a OneDrive licence, a provisioned OneDrive and free space for the leaver's files.

includeVersionHistory.description: Copy every version of each file. Off by default: only the current version is copied, which is what the free-space check counts.

200.description: Copy started. The leaver's root items are copied into /<leaver UPN> at the root of each recipient's OneDrive; existing files are kept and copies are renamed on conflict.

FolderName.description: The leaver's UPN; the folder created (or reused) at each recipient's OneDrive root.

RootItemCount.description: Files and folders at the root of the leaver's OneDrive; one copy job each.

ExpectedBytes.description: Total size of the leaver's root items (current versions).

FolderCreated.description: False when the folder already existed and was reused.

400.description: Refused before anything was written: missing or malformed input, a user not found in the tenant, a leaver without a OneDrive or with nothing to copy, more than 1,000 root items, a recipient without a OneDrive licence or OneDrive, a recipient without enough free space, or a recipient in another tenant. Results is a string naming every problem.

500.description: Graph or SharePoint failed, or the copy could not start for any recipient. Results is a string.
